known_limitations: IPv6 is not routed through or inspected by this IPv4-only engine.
IPv4 fragments are discarded; oversized UDP and path-MTU handling are not comprehensive.
User-space TCP relay lacks a complete retransmission queue and robust out-of-order reassembly.
HTTPS filtering is hostname/SNI-based; ECH or missing SNI prevents reliable hostname blocking.
MITM is experimental and does not generally filter URL paths or HTTP bodies; certificate pinning or CA-trust restrictions can prevent interception.
QUIC block drops UDP/443; fallback to TCP is application-dependent.
notes: TCP/UDP sockets are created with SocketChannel/DatagramChannel before protect() and connect().
protect() false or exception remains a hard failure to avoid recursive routing; the reason is exposed in runtime status.
MITM listener startup is synchronous and stop coordinates the accept thread and closes active sockets.
App selection errors abort startup rather than silently changing VPN scope.
Rule precedence favors a package-specific rule over a global rule for the same domain.
A real Android build and the matrix in VALIDACION.md are required before use.
hash_note: files_sha256 covers every project file except VERSION.json itself to avoid a self-referential hash.
